items.title: Only your subtitle languages
items.text: Choose a default and a second subtitle language, Arabic and English for example: subtitles in other languages are left out, from your addons and OpenSubtitles alike. Settings, Subtitles.

items.title: English only, for now
items.text: ORIGIN is in English for the time being. We are sorry to everyone who used it in Arabic: Arabic caused big problems in building the app. Arabic subtitles still work fully.
